deviceAgent.agentAliveStoppedMaking: Its agent is alive but has stopped making rounds, so this sandbox's picture of its folders and ports is as old as the last one.
deviceAgent.processKeepsBuildStarted: The running agent keeps the build it started with until it restarts, so replacing the file on disk changes nothing on its own.
deviceAgent.stopsStartsDevicesAgent: Stops and starts this device's agent process. Nothing is downloaded — the build already installed there is the one that comes up.

deviceDetail.deviceIsntSyncingFolder: This device isn't syncing a folder or holding any ports for this sandbox.
deviceDetail.noFolderDeviceOnly: no folder: this device only mirrors ports
deviceDetail.notRunningHereHint: Not running on this device: only its files or ports are here.
deviceDetail.offDeviceIsntPutting: Off: this device isn't putting this sandbox's ports on its own localhost. File syncing is unaffected.

imageView.ctrlScrollToZoom: Ctrl + scroll to zoom · drag to pan · double-click to fit
imageView.imagePreviewCtrlScroll: Image preview: Ctrl and scroll to zoom, drag to pan

sandboxDeviceDetail.devicesAgentDoesntReport: This device's agent doesn't report which paths they are. Updating it lists them here.

sandboxResourcesDialog.applyingRestartsSandboxOnto: Applying restarts the sandbox onto the same image, about a minute, and interrupts whoever is working in it. Its files (in /work) are kept, and the new share survives every later update, rollback and rebuild.
sandboxResourcesDialog.askedComputerNoNvidia: Asked for, but this computer has no NVIDIA container runtime, so the sandbox runs without it.
sandboxResourcesDialog.cpusWhole: Whole CPUs, {bounds} on this computer. Empty is no limit: every core it has.
sandboxResourcesDialog.fullAccessToComputers: Full access to this computer's devices and kernel, the way a nested Docker engine needs. Only for a tool that cannot run without it.
sandboxResourcesDialog.memoryWhole: Whole GiB, at least {min}. Empty is the default: everything this computer has beyond what it keeps for itself.
sandboxResourcesDialog.memoryWholeOf: Whole GiB, at least {min}. Docker on this computer has {engine} GiB, so a higher cap is no cap at all. Empty is the default: everything it has beyond what it keeps for itself.
sandboxResourcesDialog.passComputersNvidiaGpus: Pass this computer's NVIDIA GPUs into the sandbox: the driver rides in with them.
sandboxResourcesDialog.sandboxUsingRightNow: This is the sandbox you are using right now: this page will lose it until it is back.
sandboxResourcesDialog.savedForNextRestart: Saved for the next restart: {share}. The fields show it; Apply now restarts onto it straight away.
sandboxResourcesDialog.savingKeepsItRunning: Saving keeps the sandbox running as it is. ic keeps the new share and applies it on the sandbox's next restart through ic: Restart here, Start, an update, a rollback or a rebuild. Docker restarting the container by itself, after a crash or a reboot, does not apply it.

sandboxSandboxVerbs.deletesSandboxEverythingIn: This deletes the sandbox and everything in it — its files and its history — from that device. This cannot be undone.
sandboxSandboxVerbs.sandboxRestartsOntoImage: The sandbox restarts onto the image it ran before its last update. Its files are kept.
sandboxSandboxVerbs.sandboxRestartsOntoNewest: The sandbox restarts onto the newest image and is unavailable while that happens — seconds if the update is already downloaded, a few minutes if not. Its files are kept.
